Hero.headline:
Your Next

Career Move

Starts Here
Hero.description: LamViec360 bridges ambitious Vietnamese talent with employers who post with full context — real salaries, real teams, real expectations. No guesswork.
Hero.portraitAlt: Vietnamese professional confidently using LamViec360 on laptop in modern office

discover.label: DISCOVER JOBS
discover.heading: See every job detail before you apply.
discover.description: No more mystery listings. Every role on LamViec360 shows real salary bands, team size, day-to-day expectations, and why the role is open. You decide with confidence.
discover.imageAlt: LamViec360 job search results showing salary ranges and match scores for each role

apply.label: SMART APPLY
apply.heading: Apply smarter. Move faster.
apply.description: Your profile IS your application. Fill it once, apply everywhere. Track every response in real-time — no more wondering if your CV landed.
apply.imageAlt: Application tracker showing the real-time status of every submitted application

grow.label: KEEP GROWING
grow.heading: Upskill while you search.
grow.description: Enrol in employer-backed micro-courses, earn verified skill badges, and watch your profile climb the rankings recruiters see. Every course you finish moves you up the list.
grow.imageAlt: Course catalogue of employer-backed micro-courses with an enrol button and earned skill badges

HowItWorks.heading:
Two paths

One platform
HowItWorks.subheading: Whether you're searching for your next opportunity or building a world-class team — LamViec360 makes every step clear.

profile.title: Build Your Profile
profile.description: Build your profile in 5 minutes. Import from LinkedIn or fill in our smart form. Add skills, salary expectations, and your preferred work style.
profile.imageAlt: Profile completion interface showing skills and salary preferences in a bright, clean dashboard

match.title: Get Matched
match.description: AI-Powered matching. Our engine surfaces roles where you genuinely fit — filtered by salary, location, company culture, and growth path.
match.imageAlt: Job recommendation interface showing AI-matched roles with salary and culture fit scores

apply.title: Apply
apply.description: Apply with one tap. Your profile IS your application. Track every response in real time and schedule interviews without email chains.
apply.imageAlt: Application progress tracking interface showing status updates in real time

grow.title: Grow
grow.description: Earn badges and improve your profile. While you search, upskill with employer-backed micro-courses. Verified badges boost your profile ranking.
grow.imageAlt: Career progress dashboard showing earned badges and profile ranking improvements

post.title: Post With Full Context
post.description: Takes 10 min. Use our structured builder to add salary, team culture, growth path, and what a great day in this role looks like.

qualified.title: Receive Pre-Qualified Candidates
qualified.description: Candidates who apply have already seen your salary range and culture fit. Zero time wasted on mismatched expectations.

engage.title: Engage the Live Talent Feed
engage.description: Proactively reach candidates who match your requirements and are actively open to new roles right now.

hire.title: Hire and Track Results
hire.description: From first contact to signed offer, our dashboard tracks every candidate interaction and time-to-hire metric.

AIInterview.heading:
Practice.

Prepare.

Perform.
AIInterview.description: Prepare for interviews based on your role, experience and skills. Our AI generates tailored questions — so you walk in ready, not rehearsed.

roleSpecific.title: Role-specific questions
roleSpecific.desc: Generated from real interview data for your target role

calibrated.title: Experience-calibrated
calibrated.desc: Difficulty adjusts to your level — no generic questions

feedback.title: Instant feedback
feedback.desc: AI scores your answers and suggests improvements

questions.q1: Walk me through your process for designing a new feature from initial brief to final handoff. What tools and frameworks do you rely on?
questions.q2: Tell me about a time when user research significantly changed the direction of a product decision. What did you learn?
questions.q3: How do you approach designing for accessibility? Give me a specific example from your past work.
questions.q4: Describe a situation where you had to push back on a stakeholder request. How did you handle it?
questions.q5: What metrics do you use to measure the success of a design? How do you advocate for design quality with engineering?

AIInterview.answerPlaceholder: Type your answer here. Focus on specific examples using the STAR method — Situation, Task, Action, Result.

guidance.title: Career Guidance
guidance.description: Navigate your next move with clarity. Get expert advice on salary negotiation, career transitions, and growth strategies.

interview.description: Practice with AI-powered mock interviews. Walk into every interview knowing exactly what to expect — and how to impress.
